# Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about finding the best ticket deals

## Jump to Section

[Getting Started](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq#getting-started) [Price Tracking & Alerts](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq#price-tracking-&-alerts) [Comparing Prices](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq#comparing-prices) [Account & Watchlist](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq#account-&-watchlist) [Ticket Buying Tips](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq#ticket-buying-tips)

## Getting Started

### What is Ticket Scan?

Ticket Scan is a free ticket price comparison tool that helps you find the best deals on concert, sports, and theater tickets. We compare prices from Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, StubHub, and other major ticket platforms so you can see all your options in one place.

### Is Ticket Scan free to use?

Yes, Ticket Scan is completely free. Create an account to access all features including price tracking, watchlist, and email alerts when prices drop.

### Do I buy tickets through Ticket Scan?

No, we don't sell tickets directly. When you find the best price, we redirect you to the ticket platform (like Ticketmaster or SeatGeek) where you can complete your purchase with their buyer protection.

## Price Tracking & Alerts

### How do price alerts work?

When you add an event to your watchlist, you can set a target price. We'll monitor ticket prices across all platforms and send you an email notification when prices drop to or below your target.

### How often are prices updated?

We check prices multiple times throughout the day to ensure you have access to the most current pricing information available.

### Can I track multiple events?

Yes! You can add as many events as you want to your watchlist. Set different target prices for each event and track them all from your dashboard.

## Comparing Prices

### Which ticket sites do you compare?

We compare prices from major ticket platforms including Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, StubHub, Vivid Seats, and more. Our goal is to show you every available option so you can make the best choice.

### Do prices include fees?

Yes — we show the estimated all-in price including each platform's service fees. Estimates: Ticketmaster ~27%, StubHub ~24%, SeatGeek ~20%. Base prices are shown as a smaller line beneath. Actual fees vary at checkout based on event, seat, and delivery method, but our estimates are based on each platform's published fee structure.

### How do you estimate prices by section?

Public ticket APIs don't expose per-section pricing, so we estimate it from each venue's typical pricing pattern (upper/lower/club/floor). Estimates are most accurate at the 24 major venues we have detailed data for (MSG, Crypto.com Arena, Chase Center, etc.). For other venues, we show the aggregate price range without section estimates. Live concerts with general admission floors may price differently than the standard pattern — always verify section pricing on the platform before purchase.

### Why are prices different on each platform?

Each ticket platform sets its own prices based on seller inventory, demand, and their fee structures. This is exactly why comparing prices is so important - the same seat can vary by 20% or more between platforms.

## Account & Watchlist

### How do I create an account?

Click "Sign Up" in the top right corner. Enter your email address and create a password. That's it - you're ready to start tracking prices!

### Can I save my favorite teams or artists?

Yes! Use the Favorites feature to save your favorite teams, artists, and venues. We'll highlight relevant events and make it easier to find what you're looking for.

### How do I unsubscribe from email alerts?

You can manage your email preferences from your account settings, or click the unsubscribe link at the bottom of any alert email.

## Ticket Buying Tips

### When is the best time to buy tickets?

Generally, ticket prices are highest at the moment they go on sale, then drop over time. The sweet spot is often 2-3 weeks before the event when resellers start lowering prices. However, this varies by event - check out our blog for detailed guides.

### Are resale tickets safe to buy?

When you buy through reputable platforms like Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or StubHub, your purchase is protected by their buyer guarantees. Always stick to established platforms and avoid buying from random social media sellers.

### What if an event is sold out?

Don't worry! Sold out events often have tickets available on resale platforms. Set a price alert on Ticket Scan and we'll notify you when tickets become available at your target price.

## Still Have Questions?

Check out our blog for detailed guides and ticket-buying tips.
